questions.question: In John's vision of God's two witnesses, what does the fire from their mouths do to anyone who wants to harm them?
The beast that comes up from the Abyss will overpower and kill God's two witnesses after they finish their testimony. True or false?
After God's breath of life entered His two witnesses and a loud voice called from heaven, where did they go?

answers.text: Up to heaven in a cloud

questions.question: When the seventh angel sounded his trumpet in John's vision, what did the loud voices in heaven announce?

answers.text: The world's kingdom has become the Lord's
The holy city has been measured again
The great city has been rebuilt for good
